_about: Public-domain Sylvester Joseph Hunter (1829-1896), English Jesuit, for the Word Hoard: Outlines of Dogmatic Theology (3 vols., London: Longmans, Green; New York: Benziger, 1894-1896), a manual of Catholic doctrine in English. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 83 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
